title: Sensitive Secret File Detected: .env
description: A credential or private key file is present in the repository tree at .env.
root_cause: Sensitive configuration file was committed to repository storage without exclusion rules.
intended_behavior: Credentials and private keys must be stored in secure environment vaults or Secret Manager.

trace.description: Sensitive file stored at repository path .env

evidence.description: Credential file found on disk with non-zero byte length

conditions.description: Local repository clone or unauthenticated workspace access

execution.observed_result: File exists and contains sensitive credentials in the working tree.

remediation.strategy: Add .env to .gitignore and rotate any exposed credentials immediately.

likelihood.reason: File is plainly visible in repository working tree without authentication.

impact.reason: Exposes database credentials or private keys.

confidence.reason: Direct source inspection verified credential file on disk.
